record.question: Choose the correct answer regarding maintenance of material site accounts
options: Material-at-site account is to be kept in Form 25 /Form 35
Unused balances of materials charged direct to works are to be verified at least once / twice a year
While maintaining materials-at-site Account, detailed account should be kept only in respect of principal/ primary items
Materials-at-site account is intended to be a supporting / site account in respect of the suspense head Materials opened in the Works Abstract
record.explanation: The material-at-site account is a supporting/subsidiary account for the Materials suspense head in the Works Abstract; it is not itself the site account.
